finding: Hermes 0.19 routes source-filtered exports through list_prune_candidates, which requires ended_at IS NOT NULL. Its one-shot CLI persisted a session/messages but left ended_at NULL, so --source cli silently exported zero sessions.
safe_correction: Use an unfiltered export only from the fresh job-isolated Hermes home. Retain native session source/model/route checks and reject ambiguous multi-session cost estimates. Never fake an ended_at value or mutate the database to pass export.
limits: This is a model-free native CLI reproduction, not a new public-provider trial.
Existing real trials used the old export command; their empty exports and unknown native costs are not rewritten.
The older trial databases were not retained, so this does not retroactively prove each old empty export had the identical cause.
Native export recovery does not repair independent wire-evidence gaps or qualify M3.
privacy: No personal configuration, credentials, prompts, response bodies, pcap or TLS secrets included.
